title: Pure Mist Gold 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Gold offers a premium tobacco experience with subtle notes of sweet Cherry and smooth Cream. This sophisticated e-liquid delivers a rich and layered flavour, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy tobacco blends with a hint of sweetness. The Pure Mist High-PG collection provides a variety of VG/PG ratios to suit different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Gold provides a flavour-packed option for discerning adult vapers. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid delivers consistent quality and satisfaction.
